io.milvus.bulkwriter

Class BulkWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.BulkWriter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AutoCloseable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    LocalBulkWriter

    public abstract class BulkWriter
extends Object
implements AutoCloseable
    Abstract base class for the BulkWriter.

    Writes rows as CSV, JSON or Parquet data files and chunks them when the target size is reached. Concrete subclasses commit finished files locally or to remote storage.
